verdict.rationale: Bento's signals are its own natural-language evaluators. You describe a failure mode in plain English, each signal has an editable prompt and config, and it fires on traces in real time and backfills history; releases are also scored offline, in CI and on live traffic. The docs never say these signals are LLM-as-a-judge graders that produce per-output scores, though; they describe a detector that Bento 'trains' on your traces. missing for 10: explicit LLM-as-a-judge evaluator documentation, choice of judge model and scoring rubric/scale configuration, per-output score semantics (versus binary fires), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators
